title: Members-only rule guard
description: A check before payment: when the cashier presses Pay, the partner's service receives the priced basket and refuses a sale that holds a members-only item for a customer who is not a member, in its own words, or asks the cashier a yes/no question when the sale is at or above the shop's ID limit. The shop keeps its own rule in PP RGD Rule records (members-only items and item groups, member customer groups, the ID limit); the service reads the switched-on ones with the app's integration user, within a minute of a change, and writes nothing. It installs switched off; after install the shop makes the integration user with the role PP RGD Integration (the install makes the role), chooses it on the feed registration PP RGD Rule feed, reads what the service is sent, ticks the consent, chooses the stores it answers and switches it on. When the service is down the sale is refused, so an outage never sells a members-only item. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

doctypes.name: PP RGD Rule
doctypes.description: Your members-only rule, one rule per record: an item or an item group only members may buy, a customer group that counts as members, or the sale amount at or above which the cashier is asked for ID. The check reads the switched-on records within a minute of a change.

fields.label: Rule
fields.options:
Members-only item
Members-only item group
Member customer group
Ask for ID at or above
fields.description: Members-only item or item group: refused at Pay for a customer who is not in a member customer group (with no member customer group, nobody is a member). Ask for ID: the cashier is asked on a sale at or above the amount (several: the lowest applies).

fields.label: Item group
fields.description: The item group a line carries itself; a group above it does not count.

fields.label: Customer group
fields.description: The sale's customer is a member when the customer is in this group itself; a group above it does not count.

fields.label: Amount
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.kind=='Ask for ID at or above'
fields.mandatory_depends_on: eval:doc.kind=='Ask for ID at or above'
fields.description: One number, used in the sale's own currency whatever currency the sale is in. 0 asks on every sale.

fields.label: Switched on
fields.description: Off: the check stops using this rule within a minute.
